thread:
morgan_pm: Quick triage — PredictEmbed GA acceptance: need final SLA numbers, docs checklist, oncall coverage, pricing tier, and monitoring alerts. Can we confirm owners? :eyes:

sasha_eng: For SLA, engineering proposes: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 200ms, error-rate < 0.1% sustained. Fallback plan: route to smaller model when p95 > 400ms. Owner: sasha_eng.

tom_finops: Pricing ask: keep initial quota generous for PLG (10k tokens/day free), then tiered pay-as-you-go. Need cost-per-token estimate from infra before lock. Owner: tom_finops.

jenna_docs: Docs checklist: API quickstart, example SDK snippets, migration notes for quantized models, SLA page (targets + measurement method), troubleshooting runbook, and changelog. I'll draft the pages; need any sample cURL & SDK calls. Owner: jenna_docs.

anya_releases: Rollout plan: 2-week canary (5% traffic) -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%, with automatic rollback on alert. Canaries only weekdays 9–5 PST for first week. I'll own the rollout ops.

morgan_pm: OK owners assigned. Two urgent decisions: 1) finalize SLA thresholds (engineering proposed above) 2) confirm monitoring alerts & escalation routing.

sasha_eng: Confirm SLA numbers above. For monitoring we want these alerts: p95 latency > 250ms for 5m, error-rate > 0.2% for 5m, cache hit ratio < 60% for 10m. Pager rules: page P1 to oncall if any alert fires AND persists for >10m.

jenna_docs: For SLA page, we need to be explicit about measurement windows and exclusion (maintenance windows). I'll include example Grafana queries and a note about warm-up/cold-start variance.

tom_finops: Agree on free tier. We also need a price floor for dedicated customers — suggest committed capacity discounts (30%) and burst pricing for overage. I'll draft numbers once infra gives cost curve.

anya_releases: On canary automation — I'll add a job that checks these alerts before promoting. Also add an automated smoke test suite that runs against canary.

oncall-bot: Reminder: default rotation for PredictEmbed GA will be the "ml-inference" rota. Add secondary from "backend-sre" for 30 days post-GA.

morgan_pm: Action items recap: 1) sasha_eng: confirm alert thresholds + provide Grafana queries (due EOD) 2) jenna_docs: initial docs PR with API examples + SLA draft (due 2 days) 3) tom_finops: draft pricing bands and committed discounts (due 3 days) 4) anya_releases: canary automation + smoke tests (due next week) 5) oncall-bot note: ensure rota updated before cutover.

sasha_eng: Giving the Grafana queries now: ```
// p95 latency
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) FROM request_metrics WHERE model = 'predict-embed-v1' AND $__timeFilter(time)
// error rate
SELECT sum(errors)/sum(requests) FROM request_metrics WHERE model='predict-embed-v1'
```

jenna_docs: Will include those snippets in the SLA doc. One more question — do we want a public SLA (customer-facing) or internal SLO only?

morgan_pm: Start with internal SLO + customer-facing summary (targets + support expectations). Legal to review full SLA for enterprise.

tom_finops: Note: enterprise SLA will include credits for downtime > threshold. I'll add placeholders.

anya_releases: Small UX note: add a feature flag to opt-out of quantized fallback for customers who require deterministic outputs.

sasha_eng: Good call — implement as header X-Prefer-Exact-Model: true; default false. Documented by jenna_docs.

morgan_pm: Thanks all — logging these into the GA checklist board. If no objections, we'll lock SLA numbers and docs scope by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

jenna_docs: No objections from docs side.

oncall-bot: Scheduled reminder set for 6119999400 to verify rota changes.

morgan_pm: Closing for now — follow-ups in the checklist card.
